baseline_protocol.neutral: rating 3: no training target; remains an unknown test candidate
baseline_protocol.explicit_training: all observed positive and negative train records
baseline_protocol.sampled_training: one item from the union of user's observed train negatives (ratings 1-2) and train-unobserved globally train-known items per train positive; uniform with replacement, resampled each epoch; same pairs for every run
baseline_protocol.sampled_negative_caveat: unobserved items are unlabeled, not confirmed disliked; future interactions are not inspected while sampling
baseline_protocol.candidate_items: all globally train-known items excluding the user's earlier interactions
baseline_protocol.aggregation: macro over users with at least one warm positive target item
baseline_protocol.hit_ratio: fraction of evaluated users with >=1 relevant item in Top-K
baseline_protocol.checkpoint_selection: highest validation nDCG@K, earliest epoch on ties
baseline_protocol.test_usage: once per run after checkpoint selection
